Title: Orphaned '₹0L' text node persists across client-side route changes (Login page and Dashboard for both admin and staff)
Root Cause Summary: Likely a Recharts tooltip/legend portal element not unmounted/cleaned up on route change via React Router client-side navigation. Confirmed via live testing: element persists on Admin Dashboard -> Login (after logout) -> Staff Dashboard. Confirmed it does NOT survive a full hard page reload (element absent after browser.goto() to /users and /reports), narrowing the cause to SPA navigation cleanup, not initial render.
Notes: Visual-only defect, no functional/data impact observed. Low severity but should be fixed for UI cleanliness.

Title: Dashboard "Recent Installments" preview table displays raw negative Remain values (e.g. -₹65,000) unclamped, while the Installments list page and all aggregate KPI totals (Pending Fees, Net Balance) correctly clamp/use the non-negative remaining-fee value for the same underlying data
Root Cause Summary: Overpayment scenario exists in live test data (remainFees < 0 server-side). Dashboard's RecentInstallment preview rendering does not apply the same Math.max(0, remainFees) clamp found in InstallmentsPage.tsx. CONFIRMED 2026-07-06 (LV-7): this is display-only in one preview widget — the Pending Fees KPI (₹82,999) was independently verified to equal the sum of the correctly-clamped per-student remaining balances from the Installments list, so no financial total is affected. Severity downgraded from Medium/P2 to Low/P3 accordingly.
column18: Still needs a product decision on whether overpayment should be allowed at all (BR-07), but purely a cosmetic consistency fix now — not a data-integrity risk.

Title: Global Search result selection navigates to /admissions?search=<rollNo> but the Admissions page never reads this query param, so the list does not actually filter to the selected student
Root Cause Summary: AdmissionsPage does not call useSearchParams/read location.search anywhere; the search box remains empty and the full unfiltered list renders regardless of the query string. Confirmed live 2026-07-06 (LV-12): selected a Global Search result for roll no QA-9999, landed on /admissions?search=QA-9999, but all 8 admissions displayed unfiltered.
Notes: User-facing broken feature: clicking a global search result gives no indication the 'jump to student' didn't work, since the URL looks correct but the list silently shows everything. Fix: AdmissionsPage should read the search param on mount and seed its filter state from it.

Title: Transactions page "Next Due Date" shows a date 12 months after the last deposit date, even though the admission's Installment Cycle was set to 6 Months
Root Cause Summary: On QA-TEST-001 (Installment Cycle = 6 Months, last deposit 06 Jul 2026), the Transactions page's Next Due Date field showed 06 Jul 2027 (12 months later) instead of the expected ~06 Jan 2027 (6 months later). Not yet root-caused — could be a backend default that ignores installmentCycleMonths entirely, or the cycle field may govern a different calculation than 'next due date'. Needs backend/business-logic clarification before this can be confirmed as a bug vs. expected behavior.
Notes: Not yet filed with full confidence — flagged as a question for the stakeholder/dev team first, since the intended formula for Next Due Date is not documented anywhere in the reviewed FE source.

Title: Staff test account ("Staff2" / ashish1660webmob+13@gmail.com) authenticates successfully but does not appear anywhere in Users Management, under either Main Centre or Sub Centre
Root Cause Summary: Confirmed live 2026-07-06 (LV-23/LV-22): Users Management lists exactly 2 users (the logged-in admin + a "Super Admin") identically under both centres — Staff2 is absent from both. Root cause not yet determined. Per stakeholder decision, this is explicitly NOT classified as a bug until expected behavior is confirmed.
column18: Stakeholder-specified next verification steps (none yet performed): (1) inspect raw GET /users API response directly for Staff2's presence server-side; (2) verify centre filters aren't excluding it; (3) verify institute/tenant scoping isn't excluding it; (4) confirm with dev team whether Staff2 should be visible to this admin at all. Do not assume backend-seeded / visibility-bug / different-tenant explanations without confirming via these steps.
